prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage. Please also provide the declarations page and any other documentation sufficient to establish the coverage available for this claim.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, claim files, photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics recordings, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair or total-loss records for the vehicles involved. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
